 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 6 Nov 16, 2026 - 10:00 Astana Arena Kazakhstan host Slovakia at the Astana Arena in a UEFA Nations League C Group 3 fixture that could have a significant bearing on the final standings.
 John van't Schip's Kazakhstan side come into this match under pressure after a difficult campaign. They have lost three of their last five outings and sit fourth in the group, making this a must-improve performance if they are to avoid finishing bottom.
 Slovakia arrive in Astana as group leaders. Vladimir Weiss has built a side that has been the standout team in Group 3, and they will be looking to confirm their position at the top with a positive result in Kazakhstan.
 These two sides met earlier in this Nations League cycle, with Slovakia winning 2-1 in Bratislava in September. Kazakhstan will be looking to reverse that result on home soil, though their recent form offers little encouragement.
 Slovakia's most recent outing ended in a 2-2 draw with the Faroe Islands, a result that may have taken some gloss off their campaign but leaves their lead at the top intact. They remain the team to beat in this group.
